title: Elazar ben Yehudah of Avelim
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A tanna of a baraita. He is mentioned in [Zevachim 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.28a.12), in [Chullin 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.55b.22) as “of Ivelim,” and in [Chullin 122b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.122b.7) as “of Avelom.” Hyman gives “of Iveliyim” in chapter 1 of Tosefta Maaser Sheni and “of Kefar Ovelon” at the end of Tosefta Niddah.[^1]

notes.text: Zevachim names Elazar of Avelim. Chullin 55b has Eliezer of Ivelim, and 122b has Elazar with the place written אבלים. In the consulted [Tosefta Maaser Sheni 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Maaser_Sheni.1.7), Elazar ben Yehudah is associated with the form איש אכלים. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=514&lang=en) likewise records that form for Maaser Sheni. The reading Hyman cites from the end of Tosefta Niddah remains unconfirmed.
